evidence.evidence_text: To address PB effectively, we introduce Pos2Distill, a position to position knowledge distillation framework.

We identify distinct manifestations of PB under retrieval and reasoning paradigms, thereby designing two specialized instantiations: Pos2Distill-R1 and Pos2Distill-R2 respectively, both grounded in this core principle.
